title: Attachment.
officialText:
Signs attached to masonry, concrete or steel shall be safely and securely fastened by means of metal anchors,
bolts or approved expansion screws of sufficient size and anchorage to safely support the loads applied.
SECTION BC H106
ELECTRICAL
